name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) are hard and match the ordered steps. The hard Existence(target_picked_up) with that chain forces the key, the door opening, and the blocker move, so no extra Existence is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', and the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever holding the key, have the door open at that moment or after'.

texts: Move the ball away from the door before taking the key, which is in turn before opening the door with the key, which is before picking up the box in the other room (the final step of the ordered chain is required).
The box in the other room is picked up only after the door has been opened.
The door is opened with the key only after the agent has taken the key.
The ball is moved away from the door before the agent takes the key.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever the agent is holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards.
